outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the drawer handle in frames 24–90 (left_ego_image and wrist_image), then closes its gripper around the handle in frames 91–98 (wrist_image). The drawer visibly slides outward in frames 112–127 (image and left_ego_image). After the gripper releases and withdraws in frames 134–157, the drawer remains open with its side exposed (image and left_ego_image). No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or other side effect is visible.
